title: Persist editor preferences & layout to localStorage (pane sizes, dock/panel visibility, active tabs, view prefs) — survive refresh/restart
description: USER FEATURE: remember editor preferences and settings across sessions, including pane resizing. Today the editor's layout/view state lives in-memory in the zustand uiStore (packages/authoring-ui/src/store/uiStore.ts) and resize state via the useResize hook (added in task 1280: right-pane width, timeline height, bottom-dock height) — so it all resets on refresh/restart. Persist the durable subset to localStorage and restore on load. APPROACH: prefer zustand persist middleware on uiStore with partialize to persist ONLY layout/view-preference fields (or a dedicated persisted slice / extend preferences.ts) — choose the cleanest fit; mirror the hygiene in preferences.ts/threadStore.ts (versioned key, try/catch on read+write, graceful fallback on parse/quota failure, a schema version for future migration). VERIFY GROUND TRUTH FIRST: enumerate uiStore fields + the useResize-managed sizes and classify each as DURABLE (persist) vs TRANSIENT (do NOT persist). PERSIST (durable editor chrome/prefs): right-pane width + collapsed state, timeline height, bottom-dock height, panel/dock visibility toggles, active right-pane tab (Library/Properties/Agent), active bottom-dock tab, and genuine view preferences if present (snapping/grid/guides/rulers/edge toggles). DO NOT PERSIST (transient/per-doc): current selection, active tool maybe (decide: persisting last tool is reasonable — include if simple), modal/dialog open state, in-flight/playback state, hover, agent run state, document content. Restore persisted layout on app mount; keep desktop+narrow responsive behavior (1280) intact (e.g. don't restore a collapsed/overflow state that breaks narrow mode — clamp to viewport). TEST: persisted fields round-trip through localStorage (mock); transient fields are NOT written; restore-on-mount applies sizes/tabs; parse/quota failure falls back to defaults; clamping for narrow viewport. Build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable). Update docs/ if a preferences/persistence doc exists. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Scope: uiStore.ts (persist), useResize/Shell wiring for restore, (+ tests). NOTE: a read-only planning agent is mapping a separate AS2 feature — no code conflict.
